LESSON: DESCANT RECORDER

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.2: Descant Recorder
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Descant Recorder, part of Performing and Displaying in Grade 6 CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: How can a good tone be produced on a descant recorder?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. observe and interpret the Baroque fingering chart of the notes C D E F G A B C1 and D1

2. individually and in groups practise playing the notes C D E F G A B C 1 D1 ascending and descending on the descant recorder with appropriate playing techniques,

3. practise playing melodies based on notes C D E F G A B C1 and D1 on the descant recorder applying playing techniques and hygiene measures,

4. present melodies before peers for critique and improvement,

5. search, watch videos and practise playing melodies on the descant recorder,

6. listen to and play the main melody of the Kenya National Anthem,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. observe and interpret the Baroque fingering chart of the notes C D E F G A B C1 and D1
2. individually and in groups practise playing the notes C D E F G A B C 1 D1 ascending and descending on the descant recorder with appropriate playing techniques,
3. practise playing melodies based on notes C D E F G A B C1 and D1 on the descant recorder applying playing techniques and hygiene measures,
4. present melodies before peers for critique and improvement,
5. search, watch videos and practise playing melodies on the descant recorder,
6. listen to and play the main melody of the Kenya National Anthem,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Descant Recorder together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: The learner takes the initiative to learn how to play notes and melodies on the descant recorder.

• Citizenship: The learner plays the main melody of the Kenya National Anthem on the descant recorder.

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner observes safety and hygiene measures in the use of the descant recorders.

• Respect: The learner uses polite language in appreciating and appraising peers’ performances.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Peer education and mentorship: The learner contributes to others’ work through appraising it and providing feedback for

improvement.

• Health issues in Education: The learner prevents communicable diseases through observance of hygiene measures in the use

of the descant recorder.

Link to other learning areas:

Agriculture: The learner applies hygiene measures learnt during use and after playing the descant recorder.
